data.name: Islands: Princess Reincarnation
data.detailed_description:
Once a royal princess who held supreme power in the imperial palace, you were betrayed by trusted allies amid court intrigues. Your kingdom fell, and you met a tragic end. Yet against all odds, you are reborn, carrying all your past memories and lingering regrets.

With foreknowledge from your previous life, countless paths lie ahead. Rally your loyal followers to avenge the betrayal and restore your fallen empire. Or cast aside desire for power, leave the chaotic imperial court behind, and carve out your own fief in the wilderness. Tend crops, gather resources and build a cozy home to live a peaceful, carefree life. Various random events and fateful choices will lead you to entirely different endings.

▶ Dark Dungeon Adventure & Classic Looting

Venture into procedurally generated dark dungeons and slay ferocious monsters. Loot a massive array of equipment with random affixes. Top-tier gear and exclusive skills can only be obtained through manual exploration, preserving the authentic looting fun of classic ARPGs.

▶ Fully Automatic AFK System

When you have no time to play manually, send your character out to work AFK. The character will automatically chop wood, mine ores, go fishing and collect resources across the wilderness. It produces basic supplies steadily, freeing you from tedious repetitive work and letting you stock up materials in your spare time.

▶ Farming & Fief Construction Loop

Plow the land and grow crops, with a complete growth cycle including sowing, watering and harvesting. Combine basic resources from AFK gathering and rare high-tier materials looted in dungeons to construct workshops, barracks and other functional buildings.

Your developed fief grants permanent bonuses to attributes, item drop rates and AFK efficiency. Achieve self-sufficiency and form a full gameplay loop: Explore dungeons → Gather materials → Expand your fief → Grow stronger.

data.short_description: Betrayed and killed, a princess returns from death for a new adventure in a fantasy realm. A top-down 2D action game featuring dungeon looting, AFK gathering, base building and multiple endings. Seek revenge for the throne, or relax with farming and land management.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
